intent: Export a typed cyclic group object of order 12 identified with the already used 12-slot scaffold, so later constructions may reference an explicit Z_12 action instead of an untyped integer range.

notes.generator_nonuniqueness: A choice of generator is not canonical: Aut(Z_12) ≅ (Z/12Z)^× has 4 units {1,5,7,11}. This object does not fix an embedding Z_12 -> U(1) as canonical.

hard_limits: Does not export any canonical phase embedding nor any Berry/holonomy primitive.
Does not force a 1/2 density split from sigma_int.
Does not cut the QW-2191 O(2) family and does not export theta_1/theta_2.
